description: Northern California Earthquake Data is an open dataset on Amazon S3 listed in Registry of Open Data on AWS (urban, water, hazard and energy tags), a registry of open datasets hosted on Amazon S3 under the section "earthquakes", published or maintained by Northern California Earthquake Data Center. This dataset contains various types of digital data relating to earthquakes in central and northern California. Coverage: as stated on the registry page. The registry lists it under the tag earthquakes and hosts it on Amazon S3. Update frequency: Daily. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is stated as "NCEDC hereby grants the non-exclusive, royalty free, non-transferable, worldwide right and license to use, reproduce and publicly display in" on the registry page. Caveats: this record was written from the registry page, which was read; the data on S3 were not opened, the licence text was shortened, and the description may lag the source. It can support data-driven infrastructure planning and analysis. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-registry-of-open-data-on-aws-urban-water-hazard-tags.
